searchText: Thank you all for the calls (especially <@!415548822983278593> <@!301186049323958275> <@!243183686562873344> for your insights). I will try to add a few more points to the "issues" document today/tomorrow so we can discuss it on Monday. Will probably also extend the "spec" document with some clarifications based on what we discussed today. While there are so many channels and some get more attention than others, if we are getting more active on the ASE topic, should we have a dedicated channel for it, which can then be archived once the topic is finished? I don't mind more channels, but I also am fine with it sharing this channel since this channel is pretty quiet and as I indicated, I think there is a reasonably strong dependency on ASE for state expiry. If others want a dedicated channel I am happy to chat there though. 🙂 Recording for ASE meeting 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ofKL3MkcDrM I think I have a weak preference for a separate ASE channel. Also, sent out invites for Monday, for 30min later than this week's sessions.
